category_two_description: Putnam City School District 1 is seeking bids for eligible Category Two Network Switches, along with necessary components, as well as installation for approximately 16 campuses.Vendors should fully read and follow the attached RFP document for all details, instructions and directions.Proposals shall be submitted via email with the subject line: 2026 Campus Switch Replacement RFP Response. Send the PDF response to cboggs@putnamcityschools.org before 7/28/2025 12 noon Central Time. Please verify receipt. Questions or requests for clarification should be directed to Cory Boggs, Chief Technology Officer at cboggs@putnamcityschools.orgTechnical questions may be directed to Jared Juel, Director of Technical Services at jjuel@putnamcityschools.orgProposals that contain irregularities of any kind and/or do not comply fully with solicitation documents will be rejected at the discretion of the Chief Technology Officer.No SPAM or Robotic bids will be accepted or evaluated.
